_note: N-CMAPSS DS02 冻结清单模板。复制到 freeze/<freeze_id>.json 后逐项填实；模板本身不算冻结。三栏硬要求见 docs/paper_b_ncmapss/registry/SCHEMA.md §6。
_hash_rule: freeze_content_sha256 = sha256( 本文件去掉 freeze_ts_utc / freeze_content_sha256 / eval_start_utc 三个键之后的规范化 JSON )。规范化：键按字典序、UTF-8、无多余空白、sort_keys=true、separators=(',',':')。去掉三栏是为了避免自引用。
_ordering_rule: 合规判据：eval_start_utc > freeze_ts_utc，且 freeze_content_sha256 与已提交版本复算值一致。任一不满足，该批测试结果不具备独立确认性。

rungs.note: cumulative cycle only; deterministic; no checkpoint
same family as C-MAPSS VAN_* arms

frozen_switches.source: C-MAPSS frozen value; must NOT be re-decided from DS02 results

rungs.note: only the input layer may adapt to DS02

test_design.note: SCHEMA.md §1.3 的岔路：retrain_on_all_dev = 9 个 checkpoint × 3 台 = 27 行；若改用 loeo_checkpoints 则为 54 × 3 = 162 行，必须在此处写明并保持到评估结束

analysis_rule.primary_aggregation: per-unit RMSE then unweighted mean over units
analysis_rule.supplementary_note: capped125 是固定补充口径，不是主口径；禁止按结果择口径

segments.note: 边界预先固定；分段只用于事后评价，不得反向参与特征或选轮

analysis_rule.dispersion: per-fold seed sd AND cross-fold sd, reported separately, never conflated
analysis_rule.ci: df = n_engines - 1 = 5; seeds are not independent samples
analysis_rule.insufficient_power_rule: 三台测试机全部改善仍不足以证明总体优越（独立对称符号检验双侧最小 p=0.25）；未拒绝差异不得表述为等效

provenance.ordering_proof: eval_start_utc must be strictly greater than freeze_ts_utc; first evaluation log kept unedited
